title: Personal experiment mini-sheet — LLM inference tuning
content:
Mini tracking sheet for quick local experiments (scratchpad).

Header: Date | Exp ID | Model | Quant | Temp | Top_p | Batch | Prefix Cache | Throughput (tok/s) | Latency p50 (ms) | Latency p95 (ms) | Cost / 1k tok | Eval score (human) | Delta vs baseline

Rows:
2026-01-12 | exp-2026-01A | mpt-7b-v1 | fp16 | 0.0 | 1.0 | 1 | off | 980 | 42 | 120 | $0.90 | 3.5 | +0.0
2026-01-12 | exp-2026-01B | mpt-7b-v1 | int8 | 0.0 | 1.0 | 1 | off | 1450 | 36 | 110 | $0.62 | 3.4 | -0.1
2026-01-13 | exp-2026-02A | redwood-opt-7b | int8 | 0.0 | 0.95 | 2 | on (prefix 95%) | 2600 | 30 | 95 | $0.45 | 3.7 | +0.2
2026-01-14 | exp-2026-03A | redwood-opt-7b | q4_0 | 0.0 | 0.95 | 4 | on (prefix 80%) | 4100 | 28 | 85 | $0.32 | 3.6 | +0.1
2026-02-02 | exp-2026-04A | redwood-opt-7b | q4_0 | 0.2 | 0.9 | 8 | on (prefix 80%) | 6800 | 25 | 78 | $0.21 | 3.55 | +0.05

Quick notes / interpretation:
- int8 gives decent throughput uplift vs fp16 but slightly worse human score on prompt set A; good baseline for cost-sensitive paths.
- q4_0 + prefix caching + larger batch increases throughput a lot; p95 improves as batch increases up to the point where latency SLO risk grows (watch tail).
- Temperature/top_p changes affect score variance; for structural tasks keep temp=0.0. For chat/creative tests run separate series.

Short TODOs / next runs:
- [ ] Run exp-2026-05: redwood-opt-7b q4_0 with batch=16, measure p99 and error rate on long-context prompts (2026-02-18).
- [ ] Add cheap human eval (3 raters) for exp-2026-03A vs baseline on safety/clarity (concurrency: 1k prompts).
- [ ] Test fallback policy: route to redwood-opt-7b-int8 when dedicated capacity saturated. Record quality delta.

Ad-hoc calculations (scratch):
- Cost per 1k tokens approximate = (instance_cost_per_hour / hours_throughput) scaled -> quick number used above.
- Throughput per GPU roughly correlates: fp16 ~1k, int8 ~1.4k, q4_0+opt ~2.6k-6.8k depending on batching & prefix cache.

Sample prompts used (short):
- "Summarize the following policy doc in one paragraph, keep it factual."
- "Given user message and context, decide intent: {billing, technical, account, other}. Provide 1-sentence rationale."

Linked references / quick links:
- CONFLUENCE-1234: inference-benchmarks (notes + raw csv)
- GH-PR-456: runtime-quantization-ops (small perf patch)

Scratchpad thoughts:
- If p95 < 90ms for target route we can increase batch for cost savings without breaking latency SLO; need p99 check.
- Consider small canary that routes 5% traffic to q4_0 + prefix cache for latency/cost telemetry.

End of mini-sheet. Use this as living scratchpad — update header rows when adding new metrics (p99, error-rate) or new models.
